messages:
Priya: Quick flag 1- we pushed a large seed batch today and ops noticed ~2.8k trial owners got multiple automated touches. Owners are confused about SLA handoffs. Can we reduce noise quickly?
Alex: Oof. Short-term: suppress seed playbook for owners with a manual touch in the last 7d. Also tag seed_source so we can filter.
Jordan: Dupes come from legacy-import + webhook replays. Suggest dedupe key = email|account_id|source_hash at ingestion. Quick check SQL: ```SELECT account_id, email, count(*) FROM playbook_touch WHERE seed=true GROUP BY account_id, email HAVING count(*)>1;```
Maya: If we suppress touches, health_score might dip incorrectly. Recommend freezing seed weight in healthscore for 72h after a seed touch to avoid churn.
Priya: Proposed rollout: 1) ingest dedupe by email|account_id|source_hash 2) suppression rule: skip if last_manual_touch >= now() - interval '7 days' 3) healthscore freeze tag 'seed' for 72h 4) dry-run toggle on staging.
Alex: Paste a compact playbook snippet and I'll push to staging.
Priya: Snippet: ```{ "playbook":"seed-touch", "rules":[ {"name":"dedupe_ingest","type":"ingest","key":"email|account_id|source_hash"}, {"name":"owner_suppress","type":"suppression","condition":"last_manual_touch >= interval '7 days'","action":"skip"}, {"name":"health_freeze","type":"metric_override","metric":"health_score","duration":"72h","scope":"tag:seed"} ], "dry_run": true }```
Jordan: I'll add a post-process job to export any remaining duplicates to CSV for manual triage and send to #cs-ops.
CS Bot: Dry-run deployed to staging for playbook=seed-touch. Matches estimated=138. No live sends. deploy_id=stg-seedcheck-2790012345 :robot_face:
Maya: After validation, can we add a dashboard card showing outreach volume delta + health_score delta (7d) so Enablement and PS can see impact?
Alex: I'll review staging tomorrow AM and pair with Priya on rollout checklist.
Priya: Thanks team. I'll add the checklist to ops doc and tag you. :sparkles:
